item.title: Runners heading to Chungcheong... Kim says: “A worker to end the Myeong-Cheong battle,” Jeong says: “One-root spirit” (충청 달려간 주자들…김 “명청대전 끝낼 일꾼” 정 “한뿌리 정신”)
item.description:
Candidates Song Young-gil, Kim Min-seok, and Jeong Cheong-rae (in order of ballot number), who are challenging for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, all headed to the Chungcheong region on the 27th, the first stop for the August 17th party convention’s regional primary. This move came a day before the start of voting for party members in the Chungcheong area, aiming to gain an early advantage in the central region. Candidates Song and Kim warned that if Candidate Jeong succeeds in his re-election as party leader, the conflict between the party and the presidential office would intensify, thus moving to check Jeong. Meanwhile, Candidate Jeong emphasized, “The Democratic Party is strongest when it stays true to itself,” targeting the party’s traditional support base. <<> Candidate Song held a press conference at the briefing room of the Chungnam Provincial Government in Hongseong County, Chungnam, on the morning of the 27th. He stated, “Even though the president has indirectly and directly indicated differences in perception with Candidate Jeong, insisting there is no conflict between the party and the presidential office is difficult to convince the public,” and added, “While it’s unlikely Candidate Jeong will become party leader, if he does, the president would fall into a lame-duck status, and the party-presidential office conflict would worsen.” Song also said, “I will make Chungnam the capital of AI (artificial intelligence),” and “Ensure Chungnam becomes the biggest beneficiary in areas such as the swift relocation of secondary public institutions.” Afterwards, Candidate Song, along with candidate for Supreme Council member Seo Mi-hwa, visited the Yu Gwan-sun Martyr Memorial Hall and the birthplace of Lee Dong-nyeong in Cheonan, Chungnam, before holding a town hall meeting with party members in Chungnam. In the evening, he continued with a town hall meeting for party members in Sejong. <<> Candidate Kim, during a meeting with party members in Cheongju, North Chungcheong, on the same day, emphasized his suitability as party leader, saying, “The selection criteria are clear. We need a reliable worker to end the party-government conflict and the Myeong-Cheong battle.” Kim, who was born in Seoul, mentioned that he had ties to Cheongju, recalling his experience of being detained at Cheongju Prison during his university days for participating in democratization movements. Kim also highlighted his attention to local issues by holding consecutive meetings with Sejong Mayor Jo Sang-ho and North Chungcheong Governor Shin Yong-han, expressing his commitment to completing Sejong as an administrative capital and strengthening North Chungcheong’s bio, semiconductor, and secondary battery industries. This appears aimed at shifting the core message of the party convention toward policy, as Candidate Jeong’s side has recently intensified attacks, claiming Kim’s allegations of Shincheonji involvement are “baseless negativity that endangers the party.” <<> Candidate Jeong, whose hometown is Geumsan, Chungnam, emphasized his regional ties on Facebook, writing, “I am Jeong Cheong-rae, a son of Chungcheong born in Chungnam and raised in Daejeon. Show me the sentiment of Chungcheong.” Appearing on the YouTube channel ‘Maebulshow,’ he targeted the traditional support base, stating, “For the success of the Lee Jae-myung government, those who supported Presidents Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung must unite tightly with a one-root spirit,” and “To win the next presidential election, the pan-democratic and progressive camp must field a single candidate to face the conservative camp one-on-one.” In the afternoon, Jeong held a concert for party members in Cheongju, North Chungcheong, and expressed his intent to address local issues such as “building a national railroad network along the Gangho axis.” <<> On this day, the Democratic Party confirmed the electoral roll of 17,667 delegates and 1,527,261 party members with voting rights. The proportion of party members in the Chungcheong region among all eligible voting members is around 10%. However, it is widely assessed that the impact of the Chungcheong region’s voting results on the overall race is greater than this figure, given it is the first primary stop. At last year’s party convention, Candidate Jeong recorded a 66% vote share in the first primary region of Chungcheong, leading Candidate Park Chan-dae by over 20 percentage points, establishing an early trend of dominance. The Democratic Party will conduct online voting for party members in Chungcheong on the 28th-29th and automated response system (ARS) voting on the 30th-31st, with results announced at a joint rally for the Chungcheong regional primary on the 1st of next month. <<> Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당 당권에 도전하는 송영길, 김민석, 정청래 후보(기호순)가 27일 일제히 8·17 전당대회 첫 순회경선지인 충청 지역을 찾았다. 충청권 권리당원 투표 개시일을 하루 앞두고 중원에서 기선제압에 나선 것이다. 송 후보와 김 후보는 정 후보가 대표 연임에 성공하면 당-청 갈등이 심화할 것이라며 정 후보 견제에 나섰고, 정 후보는 “민주당은 민주당다울 때 가장 강했다”며 민주당 전통 지지층을 파고들었다.)

item.title: After four days, a 'grand real estate debate' chaired by Prime Minister Han... "We will provide targeted support for young people." (나흘 만에 한 총리 주재 ‘부동산 대토론’…“청년층 ‘핀셋 지원’ 할 것”)
item.description:
"I'd like to ask the government whether its goal for youth housing policy is to provide stable rental housing, or to build a housing ladder that leads to homeownership." (Han Chae-rin, a student at Sookmyung Women's University) (“정부는 청년 주거정책의 목표를 안정적인 임대주거 제공에 두고 있는지, 아니면 자가 마련까지 이어지는 주거 사다리 구축에 두고 계시는지 여쭙습니다.”(한채린 숙명여대 학생))

"Ultimately, it's both. Our ultimate goal is to ensure young people have stable housing, and on that basis, to create a housing system that serves as a ladder." (Kim Yoon-deok, Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport) (“결국 둘 다죠. 우리 청년들이 좀 주거가 안정될 수 있도록 하고, 또 그걸 기본으로 주거 사다리가 될 수 있도록 주거 체계를 만들어내는 게 궁극적인 목표입니다.”(김윤덕 국토교통부 장관))

At the 'National Debate on Real Estate Policy' held on the 27th at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul, chaired by Prime Minister Han Duck-soo, which lasted 2 hours and 30 minutes, questions from the 2030 generation—seen as 'housing vulnerable'—continued. This debate took place just four days after the National Debate on Real Estate Policy chaired by President Lee Jae-myung on the 23rd. (한성숙 국무총리 주재로 27일 서울 중구 대한상공회의소에서 2시간30분 동안 열린 ‘부동산정책 국민 대토론회’에서는 ‘주거 약자’인 2030 청년 세대의 질문이 이어졌다. 이날 토론회는 지난 23일 이재명 대통령 주재로 열린 부동산정책 국민 대토론회 이후 나흘 만에 열렸다.)

In his opening remarks, Prime Minister Han said, "As the Prime Minister overseeing the administration, I feel a great sense of responsibility and weight about how to resolve your difficulties and concerns regarding real estate," adding, "Young people, newlyweds, non-homeowners, multi-household residents, rental business operators, and jeonse [lump-sum deposit] and monthly rent tenants all face different situations, leading to different concerns and differing support or opposition for measures. Nevertheless, the real estate issue must be resolved." (한 총리는 머리발언에서 “행정부를 총괄하는 국무총리로서 정말 부동산에 대한 여러분의 어려움과 마음을 어떻게 해결해야 할 것인지에 대한 큰 책임감과 무거움을 느낀다”며 “청년이나 신혼부부, 무주택자, 다가구자, 임대사업자, 전월세 세입자 등 개개인이 처한 상황이 다름에 따라 고민도 다르고 찬성하는 안과 반대하는 안도 모두 다르다. 그럼에도 부동산 문제는 반드시 해결해야 한다”고 말했다.)

The government put effort into youth housing measures. (정부는 청년 주거 대책에 공을 들였다.)

Prime Minister Han said, "At the last debate (chaired by the President), President Lee said, 'Let's conduct a comprehensive survey on the marriage penalty and resolve what we can.' From that, we found about 12 items," and added, "We will set a time to provide answers soon." The 'marriage penalty' refers to disadvantages such as reduced benefits in housing subscription, loans, taxes (capital gains tax, property holding tax), health insurance, and welfare eligibility after registering a marriage. (한 총리는 “지난번 (대통령 주재 토론회에서 이 대통령이) ‘결혼 페널티와 관련해서 전수조사해 해결할 수 있는 부분들을 해결하자’ 하셔서 찾아낸 게 한 12건 정도 있다”며 “조만간 답 드리는 시간을 잡겠다”고 말했다. ‘결혼 페널티’란 혼인신고 뒤 주택 청약이나 대출, 세금(양도세·주택보유세), 건강보험, 복지 수급 등에서 혜택이 줄어들어 불리해지는 것을 일컫는 말이다.)

Young people feeling housing insecurity actively made suggestions to the government. Lee Jeong-yeol, a professional member of the Office for Government Policy Coordination's Youth Policy Coordination Committee, said, "Due to high housing prices, there are many cases where so-called 'kangaroo tribe' young people living with their parents do not receive housing support. Support criteria should be established based on their own income," and added, "We also need to consider a plan where, if the private sector supplies housing in exchange for floor area ratio incentives, 10 to 20% of the total units are mandated to be supplied to young people." A man in his 30s, an office worker named Kim, lamented, "The chance of being selected in the housing subscription lottery is so low it feels like a 'lottery subscription,' and even if selected, the high sale price makes it difficult to come up with the down payment." University student Han Chae-rin said, "What young people need is not just supplying cheap housing, but predictable housing." (주거 불안을 느끼는 젊은 층은 정부에 적극적으로 건의를 했다. 이정열 국무조정실 청년정책조정위원회 전문위원은 “높은 집값 탓에 부모와 함께 사는 이른바 ‘캥거루족’ 청년들이 주거 지원을 받지 못하는 사례가 적지 않다. 이들도 본인 소득을 중심으로 지원 기준을 마련해줘야 한다”며 “민간이 (주택을) 공급하면 용적률 인센티브를 주는 대신, 전체 가구의 10~20%를 청년에게 공급하게 의무화하는 방안도 검토할 필요가 있다”고 말했다. 30대 회사원 김아무개씨는 “청약 당첨 가능성이 낮아 이른바 ‘로또 청약’처럼 느껴지는데다 당첨되더라도 높은 분양가 때문에 계약금을 마련하기조차 어렵다”고 토로했다. 대학생 한채린씨는 “청년에게 필요한 것은 단순히 싼 집을 공급하는 것이 아니라 예측 가능한 주거”라고 말했다.)

In response, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won said, "We will carefully refine the criteria for household separation and support requirements for kangaroo tribe youth," and added, "We will maintain a strict household debt management stance, but resolve inconveniences for youth, newlyweds, and real demanders through targeted support." (이에 이억원 금융위원장은 “캥거루족 청년을 위해 세대 분리 기준 및 지원 요건을 세심하게 다듬겠다”며 “가계부채 관리 기조는 엄격히 유지하되, 핀셋 지원으로 청년·신혼부부·실수요자의 불편은 해소하겠다”고 답했다.)

In his closing remarks, Prime Minister Han said, "We will carefully refine the standards for actual residency, single-home ownership, and ultra-high-value homes," and added, "We will move beyond Seoul-centered debates and actively hold on-site meetings by topic and region." (한 총리는 마무리발언에서 “실거주, 1주택자, 초고가 주택 등의 기준을 세심하게 다듬겠다”며 “서울 중심 토론회에서 벗어나 주제별·지역별 현장 간담회를 적극 개최하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee and Lula Make 'Finger Heart' ... "Korea-Mercosur Trade Agreement Can No Longer Be Delayed" (이 대통령·룰라 ‘손가락 하트'… “한·메르코수르 무역협정 더 미룰 수 없다”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Brazil, held a summit with Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on the 27th (local time) and stated, "In an era of growing uncertainty in the trade environment, the trade agreement between Korea and Mercosur is an important task that can no longer be postponed." (브라질을 국빈방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 27일(현지시각) 루이스 이나시우 룰라 다 시우바 브라질 대통령과 정상회담을 하고 “통상 환경의 불확실성이 커지는 시대에 한국과 메르코수르 간 무역협정은 더는 미룰 수 없는 중요한 과제"라고 말했다.)

At a joint press conference following the summit at the presidential residence, the Alvorada Palace, President Lee said, "I am confident that the Korea-Mercosur Trade Agreement will expand opportunities for our companies to enter the Southern Common Market and provide Brazilian companies with new opportunities to enter the Asian market using Korea as a base." The Korea-Mercosur Trade Agreement is a free trade agreement (FTA) aimed at expanding trade and investment between Korea and the member countries of the Southern Common Market (Mercosur). ( 이 대통령은 이날 룰라 대통령 관저인 ‘아우보라다궁’에서 정상회담을 한 뒤 공동언론발표에서 “‘한-메르코수르 무역협정’은 우리 기업에는 남미공동시장으로 진출할 기회를 확대하고, 또 브라질 기업에는 한국을 거점으로 아시아 시장에 진출할 새로운 기회를 제공할 것으로 확신한다”고 말했다. 한-메르코수르 무역협정은 한국과 남미공동시장(메르코수르) 회원국 간 교역·투자 확대를 위한 자유무역협정(FTA)이다.)

President Lee added, "Brazil, as the world's 11th-largest economy and a key axis of global supply chains and food security, is expanding its role and strategic value in the international community." He continued, "Through today's talks, we declared 2026 as the inaugural year for a leap in the 'Korea-Brazil Strategic Partnership,' and following the 'Four-Year Action Plan' last February, we adopted a joint statement further concretizing the future vision for bilateral cooperation." ( 이 대통령은 그러면서 “브라질은 세계 11위의 경제 대국이자 글로벌 공급망과 식량안보의 핵심축으로서, 국제사회에서의 역할과 전략적 가치를 확대해 가고 있다”며 “오늘 회담을 통해 2026년을 ‘한-브라질 전략적 동반자 관계’ 도약의 원년으로 선포하고, 지난 2월 ‘4개년 행동계획’에 이어 공동성명을 채택하며 양국 협력의 미래 비전을 더욱 구체화했다”고 말했다.)

The two countries agreed to activate the 'Economic and Trade Commission,' a high-level platform for industrial and trade cooperation. ( 양국은 산업·통상 협력의 고위급 플랫폼인 ‘경제·통상 위원회’를 가동하기로 했다. )

Additionally, the two countries agreed to strengthen strategic cooperation in the resources and energy sectors to diversify supply chains. President Lee stated, "Brazil is a global holder of critical minerals," and "In this meeting, President Lula and I agreed on the need to expand cooperation across the entire cycle of critical mineral supply chains between companies and institutions of our countries." Brazil holds the world's second-largest reserves of rare earths. ( 아울러 양국은 공급망 다변화를 위한 자원·에너지 분야 전략적 협력을 강화하기로 했다. 이 대통령은 “브라질은 세계적인 핵심 광물 보유국”이라며 “이번 회담에서 저와 룰라 대통령은 양국 기업과 기관 간 핵심 광물 공급망의 전 주기에 걸친 협력 확대 필요성에 공감했다”고 말했다. 브라질은 희토류 매장량 세계 2위다.)

President Lee also said, "The two countries have agreed to launch a Defense Industry Joint Committee in the second half of this year and plan to pursue an 'Agreement on the Protection and Exchange of Military and Defense Confidential Information' to open new avenues for cooperation in defense and the defense industry." ( 이 대통령은 또 “양국은 올해 하반기 방산공동위원회 출범에 합의했으며 ‘군사·국방 비밀정보 보호 및 교환에 관한 협정’을 추진해 국방과 방산 분야의 새로운 협력 기회를 마련할 계획”이라고 말했다.)

They also agreed to strengthen strategic coordination in the international community. President Lee stated, "We confirmed common perspectives on major global issues, including international peace and security, peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula and in Northeast Asia, and responses to artificial intelligence and climate change, and we will strengthen cooperation with like-minded countries within and outside the region." He added, "Brazil has led denuclearization in Latin America and has consistently supported a world free of nuclear weapons and the peaceful resolution of conflicts. I once again express my gratitude to President Lula and the Brazilian government for their firm support during today's talks for our government's efforts toward the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula and the establishment of lasting peace." ( 국제사회에서 전략적 공조도 강화하기로 했다. 이 대통령은 “국제 평화와 안보·한반도 및 동북아의 평화와 안정 그리고 인공지능과 기후 변화 대응 등 주요 글로벌 현안에 대한 공통된 인식을 확인하고 뜻을 같이하는 국가들과 역내외 협력을 강화할 것”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “브라질은 중남미 비핵화를 선도하며 핵무기 없는 세계와 평화적 분쟁 해결을 일관되게 지지해 온 나라”라며 “오늘 회담에서도 한반도 비핵화와 항구적인 평화 정착을 위한 우리 정부의 노력에 확고한 지지를 보내주신 대통령님과 브라질 정부에 다시 한번 감사드린다”고 말했다. )

President Lee showed special affection for President Lula, who shares the background of being a 'former factory boy.' President Lee said, "Just as the President is missing one finger on his left hand, I also injured my left hand working in a factory as a child." He added, "Though I have a disability in my left arm, it does not hinder me from working for life or for people around the world. Instead, it constantly makes me think of the duty to care for more people and enable an overwhelming number of people to live better lives." President Lee continued, "When I visit São Paulo tomorrow, I plan to visit the metalworkers' union office where our President worked in his youth. I hope that you and I will not lose our identity as workers and will continue working together for a better life for more people in the future." After the joint press conference, the two leaders posed for photos, making finger hearts together. ( 이 대통령은 ‘소년공 출신’이라는 공통점이 있는 룰라 대통령에게 각별한 애정을 보였다. 이 대통령은 “대통령의 왼쪽 손가락이 하나 없는 것처럼 저도 어린 시절에 공장에서 일하다가 왼손을 다쳤다”며 “왼팔을 다쳐서 현재 장애를 갖고 있지만 이것이 삶이나 세상 사람들을 위한 일을 하는데 장애가 되는 것이 아니라 끊임없이 더 많은 사람들을 생각하고 더욱 압도적 숫자의 사람들이 더 나은 삶을 살 수 있게 해야 한다는 의무감을 생각하게 된다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 그러면서 “내일 상파울루에 방문하면, 우리 대통령께서 젊은 시절에 일했던 금속노조 사무실을 방문해 볼 생각”이라며 “저나 우리 대통령께서 노동자의 정체성은 잃지 않고, 끊임없이 앞으로 더 많은 사람들의 더 나은 삶을 위해서 함께 노력했으면 좋겠다”고 말했다. 양 정상은 공동언론발표를 마치고, 함께 손가락하트를 하며 사진을 찍기도 했다. )

The two leaders also presided over the signing of seven Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) covering areas such as space, sports, education, energy, and industrial technology. The MOU on space cooperation includes provisions for simplifying launch regulations between the two countries, such as 'launch permit procedures' when domestic companies use Brazilian launch sites. They also agreed to enhance cooperation in areas such as renewable energy, power grids, smart grids, and energy efficiency to accelerate the energy transition. The two countries signed seven agreements, including an 'Industrial Technology Cooperation' MOU promoting technical collaboration in seven fields: artificial intelligence (AI), semiconductors, automobiles, shipbuilding, and batteries. ( 양 정상은 7건의 우주·체육·교육·에너지·산업기술 등 양해·협력각서(MOU) 서명식 등도 진행했다. 우주협력 양해각서에는 국내 기업의 브라질 발사장 이용 시 ‘발사 허가 절차’ 등 양국 간 발사 규제를 간소화하는 내용 등이 담겼다. 또 에너지 전환 가속화를 위해 재생에너지, 전력망, 스마트 그리드, 에너지 효율 등 분야에서 협력을 증진하기로 했다. 양국은 이날 인공지능(AI)·반도체, 자동차, 조선·배터리 등 7개 분야에서 기술 협력을 촉진하는 ‘산업기술 협력’ 양해각서 등 7건을 체결했다.)

Brasília / Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 브라질리아/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: First Lady Kim Hye-kyung Says, "Even in the Amazon, They're Learning Korean... I Truly Feel the World Getting Closer" (김혜경 여사 “아마존에서도 한국어 배운다니… 가까워진 것 실감”)
item.description:
Kim Hye-kyung, the wife of President Lee Jae-myung, who is on a state visit to Brazil, on the 27th (local time) strengthened her bond with the spouse of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as they toured a Brazilian exhibition together. (브라질을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령의 부인 김혜경 여사가 27일(현지시각) 루이스 이나시우 룰라 다시우바 브라질 대통령의 배우자와 브라질 전시를 관람하며 친분을 다졌다.)

Deputy spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong reported in a written briefing that Mrs. Kim visited the Federal Court of Accounts Cultural Center in Brasília alongside Mrs. Rosângela da Silva, where they viewed an exhibition themed 'Festival of Light: Popular Festivities and Brazilian Art.' ( 김 여사는 이날 호잔젤라 다시우바 여사와 브라질리아에 위치한 연방회계감사원 문화센터를 방문해 ‘빛의 축제: 대중 축제와 브라질 미술’을 주제로 한 전시를 관람했다고 안귀령 부대변인이 서면브리핑을 통해 전했다.)

Mrs. Janja explained the origin and significance of the festivals, stating, "A variety of artworks inspired by the representative traditional festivals held annually across Brazil in June or July are on display." The Brazilian June festival 'Festa Junina' and July festival 'Festa Julina' originate from Catholic saint days and rural harvest culture, where families and neighbors gather to share harvested food, enjoy songs and dances, and strengthen community bonds. <<> Mrs. Janja noted the growing interest in Korea within Brazil. "With the rising popularity of Korean culture, including K-dramas, in Brazil, more people are learning Korean," she said. "I recently had a chance to talk with a child studying Korean in the Amazon region. I tried out some expressions I learned when I visited Korea last February." <<> Mrs. Kim responded, "Hearing that there is a child learning Korean even in the Amazon makes me truly realize how the world is coming closer as one." After the exhibition, the two first ladies also shared Brazilian traditional food made from corn. <<> Deputy Spokesperson Ahn stated, "Both first ladies agreed that culture serves as a precious bridge connecting the two countries. They concluded the schedule with hopes that this state visit will further deepen friendly cooperation between Korea and Brazil." <<> Brasília/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 잔자 여사는 “브라질 전역에서 매년 6월 또는 7월 개최되는 대표적인 전통 축제에서 영감을 받은 다양한 예술작품이 전시되어 있다”며 축제의 유래와 의미를 설명했다. 브라질의 6월 축제인 ‘페스타 주니나’와 7월 축제인 ‘페스타 줄리나’는 가톨릭 성인 축일과 농촌 수확 문화에서 유래했으며, 가족과 이웃이 한자리에 모여 수확한 음식을 나누고 노래와 춤을 즐기며 공동체의 결속을 다지는 행사다.)

item.title: 'Disciplinary Action Initiated' Jin Jong-oh: "I Will Fight Against Unfounded Factionalization"…Jo Kyung-tae to Hold Afternoon Press Conference (‘징계 개시’ 진종오 “근거없는 사당화에 맞설 것”…조경태, 오후 기자회견)
item.description:
Jin Jong-oh, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, pushed back on the 28th against the party's Central Ethics Committee initiating disciplinary proceedings against him, stating, "If this is a disciplinary action for unfounded factionalization, I will firmly oppose it." (진종오 국민의힘 의원이 28일 당 중앙윤리위원회가 자신의 징계 절차를 개시한 것에 대해 “근거 없는 사당화를 위한 징계라면 단호히 맞설 것”이라고 반발했다.)

On Facebook that day, Jin wrote, "If walking toward the public sentiment for conservative reconstruction is a crime, I will gladly accept that crime." He added, "No power has ever won public sentiment through disciplinary politics. What the People Power Party needs is not threatening disciplinary politics for factionalization, but regaining public trust," and "The public does not vote for a party that points its sword inward." He further stated, "Nevertheless, I will fully explain the circumstances and intent of the matter during the Ethics Committee proceedings," adding, "The assessment will be made not by them, but by the people and party members." (진 의원은 이날 페이스북에 “보수재건의 민심을 향해 걸어간 것이 죄라면, 그 죄는 기꺼이 받겠다”고 썼다. 이어 “징계정치로 민심을 이긴 권력은 없었다. 국민의힘에 필요한 것은 사당화를 위한 겁박스러운 징계정치가 아니라 민심 회복”이라며 “칼을 안으로 겨누는 정당에 국민은 표를 주지 않는다”고 했다. 그는 “그런데도 저는 윤리위원회 절차에서 당시의 경위와 취지를 충분히 소명하겠다”며 “평가는 그들이 아닌 국민과 당원들께서 내려주실 것”이라고 했다.)

Jo Kyung-tae, who also had disciplinary proceedings initiated against him the previous day along with Jin, announced a press conference at the National Assembly for the afternoon of the same day. In a phone call with The Hankyoreh the previous day, Jo said, "The person who should be disciplined is not Jo Kyung-tae but Jang Dong-hyuk," and pushed back, saying, "Let's see who the public opinion polls identify as the one who acted against the party, and let the person with higher response rates be disciplined." (진 의원과 함께 전날 징계가 개시된 조경태 의원도 이날 오후 국회에서 기자회견을 예고했다. 조 의원은 전날 한겨레와의 통화에서 “징계받을 자는 조경태가 아니고 장동혁”이라며 “국민 여론조사에서 해당행위자가 누구인지, (답변 비율이) 더 높은 사람이 징계받는 걸로 해보자”고 반발했다.)

Earlier, the People Power Party's Central Ethics Committee initiated disciplinary proceedings against lawmakers Kwon Young-jin, Jo Kyung-tae, and Jin Jong-oh. Jin is suspected of dispatching aides to support independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon during the June 3 by-election in Busan's North Gap district. Jo faced controversy for campaigning against the election of National Assembly Vice Speaker Park Deok-heum during a plenary session to elect the vice speaker, a position allocated to the opposition party. Kwon was reported for grabbing the collar of floor leader Chung Jin-seok and others while expressing dissatisfaction over committee assignments. (앞서 국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회는 전날 권영진·조경태·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 절차를 개시했다. 진 의원은 6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 때 보좌진을 파견해 한동훈 무소속 의원을 지원했다는 의혹을 받고 있다. 조 의원은 야당 몫 국회부의장을 국회 본회의에서 선출하는 과정에서 박덕흠 국회부의장 낙선 운동을 벌여 문제가 됐다. 권 의원은 상임위원회 배정에 불만을 표출하는 과정에서 정 원내대표 등의 멱살을 잡아 제소됐다.)

item.title: Han Byung-do: "Is This Collusion with Political Prosecutors?" Jung Jeom-sik: "Are the People Lab Rats?" (한병도 “정치검찰과 결탁했나” 정점식 “국민이 실험실 쥐냐”)
item.description:
The political tension between the ruling and opposition parties is escalating over the proposed revision to the Criminal Procedure Act, which would abolish the supplementary investigative powers, that the Democratic Party of Korea has announced it will process during the National Assembly plenary session on the 30th. (더불어민주당이 오는 30일 국회 본회의에서 처리하겠다고 밝힌 보완수사권 폐지 형사소송법 개정안을 두고 여야 간 전운이 고조되고 있다.)

Han Byung-do, the acting leader of the Democratic Party and its floor leader, said at a party strategy meeting on the 28th, "The People Power Party is equating the prosecution's authority with public safety, stirring up public anxiety and distorting public opinion," adding, "Stop this irresponsible political offensive that aims to obscure the essence of prosecution reform." He continued, "The main culprit of undermining the rule of law is the political prosecution, which has monopolized investigative and prosecutorial powers and abused its authority. The People Power Party's insistence on maintaining the prosecution's direct investigative powers is evidence of collusion between the political prosecution and the People Power Party," and warned, "I clearly caution against this irresponsible and low-level political strife." <<> Floor Leader Han stated, "The National Police Agency's Investigation Reform Committee must thoroughly uncover suspicions of inadequate investigations and cover-ups, and present a reform plan that the public can accept, one that strengthens external oversight and victim protection," and added, "The Democratic Party will take full responsibility for ensuring that this reform plan is properly implemented on the ground through necessary follow-up legislation and implementation monitoring." <<> Jung Jeom-sik, floor leader of the People Power Party, said at a party strategy meeting that day, "The Democratic Party claims this is an alternative that expands victim protection measures, but they are merely creating one department in the Serious Crimes Investigation Office, passing off the future chaos to others while trying to cover themselves," and asked, "Is it because of the Democratic Party's revenge against the prosecution and its thirst for a party convention that the people have become test subjects for a hastily drafted bill? Do they see the people as rats in a laboratory?" Rep. Park Hyung-soo, secretary of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, demanded, "The Democratic Party should stop its attempt to process this on the 30th, hold a public hearing with citizens and experts at the full committee meeting of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and conduct a proper review." <<> The Democratic Party plans to process the revised Criminal Procedure Act during the National Assembly plenary session on the 30th, after finishing article-by-article review in a subcommittee of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and then passing it through the full committee. However, since the People Power Party is expected to filibuster, actual processing is likely to occur around the 31st. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (한병도 민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 28일 원내대책회의에서 “국민의힘은 검찰의 권한과 국민의 안전을 동일시하면서 국민의 불안을 부추기고 여론을 호도하고 있다”며 “검찰 개혁의 본질을 흐리려는 무책임한 정치 공세를 중단하라”고 말했다. 그는 이어 “법치 파괴의 주범은 수사권과 기소권을 독점하며 권력을 오남용한 정치검찰이고, 국민의힘이 검찰의 직접수사권 존치를 주장하는 것은 정치검찰과 국민의힘이 결탁했다는 증거”라며 “무책임하고 저급한 정쟁을 중단할 것을 분명히 경고한다”고 했다.)

item.title: North Korea Holds Large-Scale Event for 73rd Anniversary of Armistice Agreement, Emphasizing Chinese Military Achievements (북한, 정전협정 73주년 대규모 기념 행사…중국군 업적 강조)
item.description:
North Korea held a grand event to mark the 73rd anniversary of the signing of the Armistice Agreement, strengthening internal solidarity. <<> The Rodong Sinmun reported on the 28th that a commemorative performance for the so-called 73rd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War was held in Pyongyang the previous day (the 27th), covering it on the front page. The newspaper stated that North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un attended the performance alongside war veterans and wartime contributors. In a photo of the performance venue released by the newspaper, Chairman Kim was seated next to his daughter Ju-ae, with his wife Ri Sol-ju sitting beside her. <<> Diplomatic delegations from China and Russia stationed in North Korea were also invited to the performance. In particular, the newspaper reported that videos showcasing the meritorious deeds of the Chinese military, along with Chinese songs including the "Chinese People's Volunteer Army Song," left a deep impression. The newspaper emphasized North Korea-China friendship, stating, "The eternal gratitude of the Korean people to the Chinese People's Volunteer Army soldiers, who made significant contributions to the victory in the war and the defense of world peace and security, and the North Korea-China friendship based on shared ideals and combat camaraderie will remain immortal along with the history of the great victory." <<> The performance featured the "Victory Anthem" played for soldiers who participated in the Korean War and wartime contributors, elevating the generation of victors, informing the younger generation of their achievements, and focusing on strengthening socialist system solidarity. <<> The newspaper also reported that on the evening of the 27th, a commemorative march of symbolic columns from the Fatherland Liberation War period was held at the Pyongyang Sports Square. Chairman Kim attended this event as well, observing the march of symbolic columns, including a Guard Company column led by a portrait of Chairman Kim Il-sung, a Guard Division column, a Ministry of Internal Affairs column, a mixed mechanized wagon column, and a motorcycle column, all dressed in Korean War-era uniforms as they paraded through the square. <<> In a speech delivered at the event, Defense Minister No Kwang-chol stated, "We will never tolerate the actions of forces that threaten our sovereignty and security at every moment," and added, "As a responsible and more explicit exercise of our war deterrence, we will defend our constitution, sovereignty, development interests, and ensure regional peace and security." <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (북한이 정전협정 체결일 73주년을 맞아 대대적인 행사를 열어 체제 결속을 다졌다.)

item.title: Hong Jun-pyo: "Those who brought Yoon Seok-yeol to the People Power Party, take responsibility" (국힘 ‘397억 폭탄’에…홍준표 “윤석열 데려온 자, 책임져라”)
item.description:
Former Daegu Mayor Hong Jun-pyo stated on the 27th, "At this point, shouldn't those who brought in Yoon Seok-yeol and Han Dong-hoon and ruined the conservative party in Korea now take political responsibility?" This came as former President Yoon Seok-yeol, who was on trial for spreading false information during the 20th presidential election campaign, received a sentence of one year and six months in prison with a three-year suspended sentence in the first trial that day, placing the People Power Party (PPP) in a worst-case scenario where, upon the sentence's finalization, it would have to return 39.7 billion won in election expenses reimbursed from the 2022 presidential election to the National Election Commission. (홍준표 전 대구시장이 “이쯤 되었으면 윤석열·한동훈을 데려와서 한국 보수정당을 망친 자들은 이제 정치적 책임을 져야 하지 않겠나”라고 27일 말했다. 제20대 대통령 선거 후보 시절 허위사실을 공표한 혐의로 재판에 넘겨진 윤석열 전 대통령이 이날 1심에서 당선무효형(징역 1년6개월에 집행유예 3년)을 선고받으면서 국민의힘이 형 확정 시 2022년 대선 당시 보전받은 선거비용 397억원을 중앙선거관리위원회에 반환해야 하는 최악의 상황에 놓이면서다.)

In a Facebook post that day, former Mayor Hong said, "Shouldn't the family-owned media outlets that propped up those two and misled public opinion also take responsibility? The same goes for the 'FrameTubers' (a derogatory term for far-right YouTubers) who blindly followed along." He added, "Now, please come to your senses. Because of you people, South Korea has ended up in this mess." (홍 전 시장은 이날 페이스북 글에서 이같이 말하며 “그 둘을 떠받치고 여론을 오도한 족벌언론들도 마찬가지로 책임져야 하지 않겠나? 그에 부화뇌동한 틀튜버(극우 유튜버를 비하하는 말)들도 마찬가지”라고 주장했다. 홍 전 시장은 “이제 제발 정신 좀 차려라”라며 “니들 때문에 대한민국이 이 모양 이 꼴”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Former Mayor Hong, who left the PPP after losing in the party's primary for the 2024 presidential election, has consistently criticized former President Yoon, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, and the PPP. In September 2024, regarding allegations of "political-religious collusion" raised against the Yoon administration and the PPP, he argued, "After Yoon joined the party, the party was swayed by the influx of Shincheonji, Unification Church, and Jeon Kwang-hoon factions. It should stop trying to make excuses, apologize to the public, sever ties with those factions, and expel those who brought them in from politics." In October 2024, he also criticized the PPP's nomination of former President Yoon and former Employment and Labor Minister Kim Moon-soo as presidential candidates, calling it "the worst choice prioritizing private interests over national interests." (지난해 4월 국민의힘 대선 경선에서 탈락한 뒤 탈당한 홍 전 시장은 윤 전 대통령과 한동훈 무소속 의원, 국민의힘에 대한 비판을 지속적으로 제기한 바 있다. 홍 전 시장은 지난해 9월 윤석열 정부와 국민의힘에 제기된 ‘정교유착’ 의혹에 대해 “윤석열 입당 후 그 당에 몰려든 신천지, 통일교, 전광훈 세력 등에 휘둘린 그 당은 더 이상 견강부회하지 말고 대국민 사과를 하고, 그 세력들과 절연하고 그 세력들을 끌어들인 사람들은 정계 퇴출시키라”고 주장했다. 지난해 10월엔 윤 전 대통령과 김문수 전 고용노동부 장관을 국민의힘 대선 후보로 내세운 것을 두고 “국익을 져버린 사익을 앞세운 최악의 선택이었다”고 비판하기도 했다.)

In January 2025, former Mayor Hong again stated that for the PPP to recover, it needed to punish former President Yoon and lawmaker Han and sever ties with far-right forces. He claimed, "The main culprits who ruined that party (PPP) are the two mercenary forces, Yoon Seok-yeol and Han Dong-hoon," adding, "The mercenaries' brawling has ruined the conservative party in South Korea." (홍 전 시장은 지난 1월에도 국민의힘이 재기하려면 윤 전 대통령과 한 의원을 응징하고, 극우세력과 절연하는 것이 필요하다고 말했다. “그 당(국민의힘)을 망친 장본인은 윤석열·한동훈 두 용병 세력”이며 “용병들의 난투극이 한국 보수 정당을 망친 것”이라는 주장이다.)

By Lee Yoo-jin, Reporter yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik: “Constitutional Amendment Discussions to Gain Full Momentum Next Year… Presidential Re-election is a Matter of Public Choice” (조정식 “개헌 논의 내년 본궤도…대통령 연임은 국민 선택 문제”)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik stated on the 28th, “I will form a special committee on constitutional amendment through consultations between the ruling and opposition parties, and bring the discussion on constitutional revision onto the main track next year.” (조정식 국회의장은 28일 “여야 협의로 국회 개헌특위를 구성해 내년에 개헌 논의를 본궤도에 올려놓겠다”라고 밝혔다.)

Speaker Woo made this remark during his first press conference since taking office, held at the National Assembly on the same day, saying, “As I proposed to the people on the previous Constitution Day, I will steadily and boldly pursue constitutional amendment.” He added, “I will soon launch a Constitutional Amendment Advisory Committee under the direct authority of the Speaker to organize the roadmap and agenda for constitutional revision,” and mentioned, “I will also build a digital platform for direct public participation in the discussion process.” (조 의장은 이날 국회에서 취임 후 첫 기자간담회를 열고 “개헌은 지난 제헌절에 국민께 제안 드린 대로 차분하고 담대하게 추진하겠다”라며 이렇게 밝혔다. 이어 “곧 의장 직속 헌법개정자문위원회를 출범시켜 개헌 로드맵과 의제를 정리하겠다”면서 “논의 과정에 국민이 직접 참여할 수 있는 디지털 플랫폼을 구축하겠다”고 했다.)

In his Constitution Day address on the 17th, Speaker Woo proposed a ‘people’s sovereignty constitutional amendment,’ citing key elements of the proposed revision, such as incorporating the spirit of the May 18 Democratization Movement into the preamble of the Constitution, restricting the president’s authority to declare martial law, reorganizing the power structure, and reforming election management. (조 의장은 지난 17일 제헌절 경축사에서도 ‘국민주권 개헌’을 제안하면서, 개헌안 주요 내용으로 △5·18 민주화운동 정신의 헌법전문 수록 △대통령 계엄선포권 제한 △권력구조 개편 △선거관리 개혁 등을 꼽았다.)

In response to reporters’ questions asking for his stance on the reservations from the opposition, which suspects that the ultimate goal may be to extend the current president’s term, Speaker Woo replied, “That discussion is premature,” but added, “When it comes to reorganizing the power structure, I believe the issue of the current president’s re-election is a matter of public opinion and choice by the sovereign citizens.” (‘야권에서 최종적 목표가 현직 대통령 임기 연장 목표로 하는 게 아니냐며 개헌을 반대하고 있다’며 이에 대한 입장을 묻는 취재진의 질문에 조 의장은 “그 이야기는 시기상조”라면서도 “권력구조 개편과 관련해서 현직 대통령 연임 문제는 주권자의 국민 여론과 선택의 문제라고 생각한다”라고 답했다.)

Regarding the operation of the National Assembly, Speaker Woo stated, “I will regularize plenary sessions to enhance predictability, and establish a ‘People’s Livelihood Legislation Processing Week’ to swiftly handle bills directly related to the people’s lives and safety,” and emphasized, “I will operate a ‘People’s Livelihood Bill Consultative Body,’ agreed upon by both the ruling and opposition parties, to process people’s livelihood bills with speed.” (조 의장은 국회 운영과 관련해서는 “본회의를 정례화하여 예측 가능성을 높이고, 국민의 삶과 안전에 직결된 법안을 신속 처리하는 ‘민생입법 처리주간’을 두겠다”면서 “여야가 동의한 ‘민생법안협의체’를 가동해 민생법안을 속도감 있게 처리하겠다”라고 밝혔다.)

Amid the ruling and opposition parties barely reaching an agreement on the composition of the Assembly on the 23rd, 54 days after its formation, Speaker Woo said, “I will quickly put stalled people’s livelihood legislation and reform legislation back on track,” adding, “We must pass the amendment to the Carbon Neutrality Framework Act, which has already been ruled unconstitutional, by the end of August.” He also stated, “In the future, bills that pass through standing committees and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee to reach the plenary session will be processed within the relevant session as a principle.” (지난 23일 여야가 개헌 54일 만에 가까스로 원 구성 합의를 도출해 낸 가운데 조 의장은 “멈춰있던 민생입법, 개혁입법을 빠르게 본궤도에 올리겠다”라며 “당장 헌법불합치 결정이 난 탄소중립기본법 개정안을 8월 말까지 통과시켜야 한다”고 밝혔다. 또 “앞으로 상임위와 법사위를 통과해 본회의에 올라온 법안들은 해당 회기 내 처리를 원칙으로 할 것”이라고 했다.)

Speaker Woo emphasized, “I will prioritize dialogue and compromise, but I will prevent state affairs from being held hostage and halted by political strife,” and added, “I will engage in dialogue without hesitation, mediate, and make decisions from the people’s side when necessary—becoming a Speaker who decides when a decision is needed.” He also promised to advance the construction of the National Assembly Sejong Office, pass the Special Act on the Administrative Capital by year-end, and build a branch of the National Assembly Library in Gwangju. (조 의장은 “대화와 타협을 최우선에 두되, 국정이 정쟁에 발목 잡혀 멈춰 서는 일은 막겠다”라며 “대화하되 머뭇거리지 않고, 중재하되 국민의 편에서 결단할 때는 결단하는 의장이 되겠다”라고도 강조했다. 또 국회 세종의사당 건립, 행정수도특별법 연내 통과, 국회도서관 광주분원 건립 등도 추진하겠다고 약속했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min: jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: Proposal to Separate Party Leadership and Nomination Powers Is "An Idea That Disregards Party Members" (장동혁, 당대표-공천권 분리 주장에 “당원 무시 발상”)
item.description:
In response to the recent calls within the People Power Party to separate the roles of party leader and the authority over candidate nominations, leader Jang Dong-hyuk criticized it as "a shallow idea that calculates personal gains and losses, and if so, it's a misguided notion that completely ignores party members, who are the Party's core." Emphasizing a "party member-centered" approach, he argued, "The idea of disregarding the will of party members and having nominations conducted by someone not elected by party members completely contradicts the basic principles of party politics." (국민의힘 내부에서 최근 제기되는 ‘당대표-공천권 분리론’에 대해, 장동혁 대표가 “자신들의 유불리를 따지는 얄팍한 생각에서 나온 것이라면, 당의 중심인 당원들을 완전히 무시하는 잘못된 발상”이라고 비판했다. 그는 ‘당원 중심’ 기조를 강조하면서 “당원들의 의사를 무시하고, 당원들이 선출하지 않은 누군가에 의해서 공천을 하겠다는 발상은 정당정치의 기본원칙과 완전히 모순된다”고 주장하기도 했다.)

Jang made these remarks while attending the "Award Ceremony for Appointment Letters for the People Power Party's Public Official Evaluation Innovation Task Force (TF)" held at the National Assembly that morning. He stated, "I emphasize that the opinions of party members should be significantly reflected in the evaluation of public officials in some way. This is the path to becoming a party centered on its members, and that is the first step toward a party centered on the people." He added, "Once the Party's goals are set, we must work together and nominate those who fight hard for the people alongside party members—whether it's the ruling party acting like a ruling party, or the opposition party acting like an opposition party, those who can fight properly." (장 대표는 이날 오전 국회에서 열린 ‘국민의힘 선출직 공직자 평가혁신 태스크포스(TF) 임명장 수여식’에 참석해 “어떤 식으로든 당원들의 의사가 공직자 평가에 비중 있게 포함돼야 한다는 말씀을 드린다. 그것이 당원 중심 정당으로 가는 길이고, 당원 중심 정당이 국민 정당으로 가는 첫걸음이기 때문”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 장 대표는 그러면서 “당의 목표가 설정되면 함께 힘을 모아 당원과 함께 국민을 위해 열심히 싸우는 사람, 여당이면 여당답게, 야당이면 야당답게 제대로 싸울 수 있는 사람을 공천해야만 한다”고 했다.)

Jang's remarks appear to be a response to recent reform proposals within the Party advocating for reducing or abolishing the party leader's role, voiced by those pressing for Jang to take responsibility. The internal faction of younger lawmakers, "Alternatives and Futures," has also announced a reform plan that completely separates the authority over candidate nominations from the party leader. (장 대표의 이런 발언은 최근 장 대표 책임론을 주장하는 쪽에서 표출된 당대표 역할 축소·폐지 개혁안에 대한 반응으로 읽힌다. 당내 소장파 의원 모임 ‘대안과 미래’에서는 당대표에게서 공천권을 완전히 분리하는 내용의 개혁안이 발표되기도 했다.)

"If we're talking about abolishing the party leader and moving toward a parliamentary-centered party, I believe the opinions of party members should be reflected by at least 50% in elections for the floor leader," Jang said. "If we move toward that kind of party, I could reconsider the direction of a parliamentary-centered party." (장 대표는 “당대표를 없애고 원내 중심 정당으로 가겠다고 한다면, 적어도 원내대표 선거에서 당원들의 의사가 50% 이상은 반영돼야 한다고 생각한다”며 “그런 정당으로 나아간다면 원내 중심 정당 방향성에 대해서도 다시고민해볼 수 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the proposal to conduct all nominations through 100% open primaries with public participation, Jang stated, "In the recommendation of candidates for public office, completely ignoring the will of party members is something that cannot happen in party politics. It would not filter out those who do no work in the legislature but cling to the media or engage in self-promotion. It would ultimately block the entry of political newcomers." (그는 100% 국민경선으로 공천하자는 주장에 대해서는 “공직자 후보 추천에 있어서 당원 의사가 완전 무시된다는 것은 정당정치에서 있을 수 없는 일”이라며 “원내에서 일은 하지 않고 언론에 매달리거나 자기 정치하는 사람을 걸러낼 수 없다”, “정치 신인의 진입을 결국 차단하게 될 것”이라는 입장을 밝혔다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party: "It's Stoking the Flames for Extending the Regime"... Reacts Strongly to Cho Jung-sik's Remarks on 'Reelection as Public Choice' (국힘 “정권 연장의 군불 지폈다”…조정식 ‘연임 국민 선택’ 발언에 반발)
item.description:
On the 28th, the People Power Party (PPP) strongly opposed National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik's remarks that "regarding the restructuring of power, the issue of the incumbent president's reelection is a matter of public opinion and choice," calling it "stoking the flames for extending the regime." (국민의힘이 28일 조정식 국회의장이 “권력구조 개편과 관련해 현직 대통령 연임 문제는 국민 여론과 선택의 문제”라고 언급한 것에 대해 “정권 연장의 군불을 지폈다”며 강하게 반발했다.)

PPP Senior Spokesperson Park Choong-kwon issued a written commentary today, stating, "The discussion on extending the (presidential) term is a dangerous idea that undermines the principles of democracy, and it is a strategically self-serving attempt to seek regime extension under the pretext of 'public choice.'" He added, "The Speaker, who should uphold the separation of powers, following suit and paving the way for regime extension is a provocation threatening the constitutional order." He further asserted, "Reducing the constitution, the foundation of the nation, to a tool for extending the regime's lifespan is absolutely unacceptable." <<> Senior Spokesperson Park urged, "Speaker Cho Jung-sik must immediately halt strategic discussions on constitutional amendment and strongly return to his primary duty as Speaker—checking the ruling party's legislative overreach and normalizing the National Assembly." <<> Earlier, in his first press conference held this morning at the National Assembly's Sarangjae, Speaker Cho said, "Through consultations between the ruling and opposition parties, we will form a special committee on constitutional amendment and put discussions on track next year." He announced plans to launch an advisory committee on constitutional amendment directly under him to outline a roadmap and agenda, and to build a digital platform for direct public participation. His remark that "the issue of the incumbent president's reelection or term extension is a matter of public choice" came in response to a reporter's question: "The opposition is opposing constitutional amendment, suggesting the ultimate goal is extending the incumbent president's term." <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr ( 박충권 국민의힘 수석대변인은 이날 서면 논평을 내어 “(대통령) 임기 연장 논의는 민주주의의 원칙을 흔드는 위험한 발상으로, 국민의 선택’이라는 핑계 뒤에 숨어 정권 연장을 도모하려는 정략적 사심”이라며 “삼권분립을 수호해야 할 국회의장이 이에 편승해 정권 연장의 길을 열어주는 행태는 헌정 질서를 위협하는 도발”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “국가의 근본인 헌법을 정권의 수명 연장 수단으로 전락시키는 것은 결코 용납될 수 없다”고 했다. )

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "If They Attempt a Constitutional Amendment to Extend President Lee's Term, He Won't Complete His Remaining Term" (장동혁 “이 대통령 임기 연장 개헌 시도 땐 남은 임기 못 채울 것”)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 28th warned National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik regarding his mention of the possibility of allowing the incumbent president to serve consecutive terms, saying, "Go ahead and try to push through a constitutional amendment for term extension. You won't even finish the remaining term." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 28일 조정식 국회의장의 현직 대통령 연임 가능성 언급에 대해 “임기 연장 개헌 한 번 시도해보라. 남은 임기도 다 채우지 못할 것”이라고 경고했다.)

Jang wrote on Facebook that day, "They keep attaching constitutional amendments to everything, and now they've finally revealed their true colors." He added, "President Lee Jae-myung has yet to respond to demands that he declare he will not seek a consecutive term. The nullification of trials, the May 18 constitutional amendment, and even the constitutional revision regarding the election commission—all of it was ultimately a build-up for a 'term extension amendment.' They made Cho Jung-sik, Lee's former special advisor, the National Assembly Speaker just to keep the presidency going." (장 대표는 이날 페이스북에 “뭐든지 개헌을 갖다 붙이더니 드디어 검은 속내를 드러낸 것”이라며 이렇게 적었다. 장 대표는 이어 “이재명 대통령은 ‘연임하지 않겠다’고 선언하라는 요구에 지금까지도 대답을 하지 않고 있다”며 “재판 취소도, 5·18 개헌도, 심지어 선관위 개헌도, 결국 ‘임기 연장 개헌’의 빌드업이었다. 대통령 계속하려고, 자기 특보였던 조정식을 국회의장 시킨 것”이라고 주장했다.)

PPP lawmakers also joined in the criticism. Lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun said, "The Speaker's advocacy for a constitutional amendment is a legislative coup that sells out national sovereignty to power. Speaker Cho must immediately retract his remarks." Lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun reacted, saying, "This proves to the world that the constitutional amendments the government and ruling party have been pushing for were not good-faith efforts for the people, but rather a strategic tool driven by President Lee Jae-myung's ambition for prolonged rule and power extension." (국민의힘 의원들도 일제히 비판했다. 윤상현 의원은 “국회의장의 개헌론은 국민주권을 권력에게 팔아먹는 입법쿠데타”라며 “조 의장은 해당 발언을 즉각 철회하라”고 했다. 김기현 의원은 “(정부·여당이) 외쳐온 개헌이 국민을 위한 선의가 아니라 오직 이재명 대통령의 장기 집권과 권력 연장을 위한 야욕의 정략적 도구였음을 천하에 입증한 것”이라고 반발했다.)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon criticized, "This is the Lee Jae-myung regime preparing a 'Plan B: Constitutional Amendment for Lee's Consecutive Term' in case 'Plan A: Dropping the Indictment of Lee Jae-myung' becomes difficult." Han added, "This is a path to an absolutely unacceptable dictatorship. Whether the judicial system collapses, the stock market crashes, or the real estate market crumbles, the government and ruling party are obsessed only with saving Lee Jae-myung, rather than the lives of the people." (한동훈 무소속 의원은 “플랜에이(A) ‘이재명 공소취소’가 어려워질 때를 대비하여 플랜비(B) ‘이재명 연임 개헌’을 준비하는 이재명 정권”이라고 비판했다. 한 의원은 그러면서 “절대 용납할 수 없는 독재로 가는 길”이라며 “(정부·여당이) 사법제도가 붕괴하든 주식시장이 망가지든 부동산시장이 무너지든 국민의 삶보다는 이재명 살리기에만 몰두하고 있다”고 했다.)

Earlier that morning, during his first press conference as Speaker at the National Assembly's Sarangjae, Cho Woo-won-shik addressed the possibility of a constitutional amendment for a consecutive presidential term, saying, "Isn't it premature to discuss this?" while also stating, "Regarding the restructuring of the power structure, the issue of the incumbent president's consecutive term is ultimately a matter for the sovereign people to decide." (앞서 조 의장은 이날 오전 국회 사랑재에서 열린 취임 첫 기자간담회에서 현직 대통령 연임 개헌 가능성에 대해 “이러쿵저러쿵 시기상조 아닌가”라면서도 “권력 구조 개편과 관련해서 현직 대통령 연임 문제는 결국 주권자인 국민의 선택 문제”라고 말했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lula embraces President Lee in ‘140-minute talks’…Expanding cooperation in rare earths and more (이 대통령 껴안은 룰라 ‘140분 회담’…희토류 등 협력 확대)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Brazil, adopted a ‘Korea-Brazil Joint Statement’ on the 27th (local time) after discussing strengthened cooperation with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in areas such as trade and investment, resources and energy, defense, space, and aviation. <<> In the meeting, the two leaders agreed to “further strengthen bilateral cooperation as strategic partners linking Latin America and Asia to respond to complex challenges in the international community,” Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jung said in a briefing. <<> First, in the context of growing uncertainty in the international trade environment, the two leaders agreed that negotiations for the Korea-Mercosur (Southern Common Market) Trade Agreement (TA) are a key foundation for a new leap in bilateral economic cooperation and decided to advance them. The Korea-Mercosur Trade Agreement, aimed at expanding trade with Brazil and other South American common markets, is expected to help South Korean companies enter the South American market and diversify the supply chain for critical minerals if prolonged stalled negotiations resume. <<> To that end, they agreed to establish a Korea-Brazil bilateral working group to announce the resumption of negotiations at the 69th Mercosur Summit to be held in December. The representatives from each side will be Policy Planning Director Kim Yong-beom and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, respectively. <<> Additionally, the two leaders agreed to expand mutually beneficial cooperation across the entire supply chain of critical minerals, including rare earths, by linking Brazil's abundant critical mineral resources with South Korea's advanced industrial and technological capabilities, and to actively support the establishment of intergovernmental cooperation channels and business-to-business collaboration. <<> President Lee held a summit meeting with President Lula that far exceeded the scheduled time, lasting 140 minutes. The two leaders, who share the common background of being 'former child laborers,' showed special affection for each other throughout the meeting. When President Lee and his wife arrived at the Alvorada Palace, President Lula's official residence, Lula embraced Lee with open arms. This marked the fourth time Lula has held a summit meeting at the residence, following Chinese President Xi Jinping, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and former French President Jacques Chirac. <<> In a joint press statement, President Lula made a 'surprise invitation' to President Lee, saying, “As a symbol of the technical cooperation we can pursue going forward, we will have the opportunity to jointly launch a new launch vehicle at the Alcântara Launch Center in September, and I hope you can attend in person.” President Lee responded, "I would like to come and see it firsthand, but if that’s difficult, I will at least check it via video." <<> President Lee also mentioned their shared experience as factory workers. He said, “Just as the President is missing a finger on his left hand, I also injured my left hand while working in a factory as a child. Although I have a disability from injuring my left arm, this doesn’t hinder me from working for life or for the people of the world. It makes me think of the duty to constantly think of more people and ensure that an overwhelming majority can live better lives.” President Lee added, “When I visit São Paulo tomorrow, I plan to visit the metalworkers' union office where President Lula worked in his youth. I hope that neither the President nor I lose our worker identity and continue to work together for a better life for more people going forward.” After the joint press statement and a commemorative photo, Lula was the first to make a 'finger heart' gesture, and President Lee smiled and made the same gesture. The presidential couple concluded their summit schedule that evening by attending a cultural performance and reception hosted by President Lula and his wife at the Itamaraty Palace, Brazil’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs. <<> Brasília/Seo Young-ji reporter yj@hani.co.kr (브라질을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 27일(현지시각) 루이스 이나시우 룰라 다 시우바 대통령과 교역·투자, 자원·에너지, 방산·우주·항공 등 분야에서 협력 강화를 논의한 뒤 ‘한-브라질 정상 공동성명’을 채택했다.)

item.title: Yang Hyang-ja: "People Power Party Bears Responsibility for Failing to Offer Proper Options to the Public" (양향자 “국힘, 국민에 제대로 된 선택지 못 준 책임 있어”)
item.description:
Regarding the situation where the People Power Party would have to return the 39.7 billion won in election expenses it received after the 2022 presidential election if the Supreme Court upholds the first-instance verdict against former President Yoon Suk-yeol for violating the Public Official Election Act, People Power Party Supreme Council member Yang Hyang-ja stated, "We need to wait for the Supreme Court's decision," but added, "Apart from the final court ruling, the political responsibility is very heavy." This implies that the People Power Party also bears responsibility for failing to properly vet its candidate. (윤석열 전 대통령의 공직선거법 위반 혐의 1심 선고가 대법원에서 확정될 경우 국민의힘이 2022년 대선 당시 보전받은 선거비용 397억원을 반환해야 하는 데 대해 양향자 국민의힘 최고위원이 “대법원까지 지켜봐야 한다”면서도 “법원의 최종 판단과 별개로 정치적 책임이 매우 무겁다”고 말했다. 후보를 제대로 검증하지 못한 국민의힘에도 책임이 있다는 취지다.)

On the 28th, Supreme Council member Yang said on Channel A's 'Political Signal,' "It's not that the people made the wrong choice, but that the party failed to provide the people with a properly prepared option, and we cannot be free from that responsibility." (양 최고위원은 28일 채널에이(A) ‘정치시그널’에서 “국민이 잘못 선택한 것이 아니라 정당이 국민께 제대로 준비된 선택지를 드리지 못한 책임에서 자유롭지 못하다”며 이같이 말했다.)

She continued, "The responsibility should not be placed solely on former President Yoon," adding, "It’s the failure of our party, which did not properly vet him, of our politicians who, driven by the desire to win, ignored the warning signs, and of all of us who prioritized loyalty to one person over the party's values." (이어 “책임을 윤 전 대통령 개인에게만 돌려서도 안 된다”며 “(후보를) 제대로 검증하지 못한 우리 당, 승리에 급급해서 경고음을 외면한 우리 정치인들, 한 사람에 대한 충성을 당의 가치보다 앞세운 우리 모두의 실패”라고 말했다.)

Supreme Council member Yang added, "Going forward, we must create a party that can properly nurture and vet people, and clearly warn against wrongdoing, even if it’s within the same party," and said, "We must reflect painfully, but I believe our responsibility extends not just to reflection but to changing the system and culture." (양 최고위원은 “앞으로는 사람을 제대로 육성하고 검증하고 잘못된 권력에는 같은 당이라도 분명히 경고할 수 있는 정당을 만들어야 한다”며 “뼈아프게 반성하되 그 반성에 머무르지 않고 제도와 문화를 바꾸는 것까지가 우리의 책임이라고 생각한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, on the 27th, the 21st Criminal Division of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Jo Soon-pyo) sentenced former President Yoon to one year and six months in prison, suspended for three years, for violating the Public Official Election Act. The court deemed as 'false' all of former President Yoon's explanations regarding the suspicions of 'introducing a lawyer' and a 'connection to a shaman' raised during the 20th presidential election campaign. (앞서 서울중앙지법 형사21부(재판장 조순표)는 27일 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 기소된 윤 전 대통령에게 징역 1년6개월에 집행유예 3년을 선고했다. 제20대 대선 후보 시절 제기된 ‘변호사 소개’ 및 ‘무속인 인연’ 의혹에 대한 윤석열 전 대통령의 해명을 모두 ‘허위’로 판단한 것이다.)

Under election law, if a presidential candidate is elected or receives more than 15% of the vote, the National Election Commission reimburses the full election expenses. However, if the candidate is sentenced to a penalty that would nullify the election (a fine of 1 million won or more) and the verdict is finalized, the political party must return the full amount. The Supreme Court's ruling is expected as early as January next year. Former President Yoon is the first former president to receive a sentence that would nullify the election for violating election law. (선거법에 따라 대선 후보자가 당선되거나 15% 이상의 득표율을 얻으면 중앙선거관리위원회로부터 선거비용 전액을 보전받는데, 당선 무효형(벌금 100만원 이상)을 선고받아 확정되면 정당이 이를 전액 반환해야 한다. 대법원 판결은 이르면 내년 1월 나올 전망이다. 선거법 위반 혐의로 당선무효형을 선고받은 전직 대통령은 윤 전 대통령이 처음이다.)

As the People Power Party faces having to fully return the 39.7 billion won, Han Byeong-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 27th, "This is a just retribution for the mistake of recommending a candidate who was unqualified, giving rise to a prosecutorial dictatorship regime, and fundamentally shaking South Korea’s constitutional order." (국민의힘이 397억원을 고스란히 반환할 처지에 놓이자 한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 27일 “자격 미달인 후보를 추천해 검찰독재정권을 탄생시키고, 대한민국 헌정질서를 뿌리째 뒤흔든 과오에 대한 당연한 응보”라고 말했다.)

The People Power Party tried to turn the tables against the Democratic Party. Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon of the People Power Party, bringing up the case where Democratic Party leader Lee Jae-myung was indicted for allegedly claiming he didn't know former Seongnam Urban Development Corporation head Kim Moon-ki during the 2022 presidential election and is undergoing trial, argued on the 27th, "Our case is at the first instance, while the Democratic Party's case involving Leader Lee has been sent back for retrial from the Supreme Court with an effectively finalized guilty verdict, and the amount is even larger. If we have to sell our party headquarters, it’s only right that the Democratic Party sells theirs first." (국민의힘은 화살을 민주당 쪽으로 돌리려 했다. 박성훈 국민의힘 수석대변인은 27일 이재명 대통령이 2022년 대선 당시 김문기 전 성남도시개발공사 처장을 몰랐다고 한 혐의 등으로 기소돼 재판을 받아온 사건을 거론하며 “저희는 1심이고, 민주당은 이재명 대통령 건에 대해서는 대법원의 사실상 확정판결에 준하는 유죄 취지 파기 환송으로, 금액도 더 크다. 당사를 팔아야 한다면 민주당 당사를 먼저 파는 게 맞다”고 공세를 폈다.)

Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ‘Fast Track Period Shortened from 330 to 90 Days’: National Assembly Act Passes Operations Subcommittee (‘패스트트랙 기간 330→90일 단축’ 국회법, 운영위 소위 통과)
item.description:
The National Assembly’s Operations Improvement Subcommittee of the Steering Committee passed an amendment to the National Assembly Act on the 28th, led by the Democratic Party of Korea, reducing the review period for fast-track bills from 330 days to 90 days. (국회 운영위원회 국회운영개선소위원회가 28일 더불어민주당 주도로 신속처리안건(패스트트랙)의 심사 기간을 330일에서 90일로 줄이는 국회법 개정안을 의결했다. )

Cheon Jun-ho, a Democratic Party member and chair of the National Assembly Operations Improvement Subcommittee, met with reporters at the National Assembly and said, “Typically, the fast track takes about 330 days for review, but the current legislative processing deadline is shorter than that. Since bills are being reviewed and processed within about 300 days, we determined there is a need to shorten the processing period to match the purpose and name of this system.” (민주당 소속인 천준호 국회운영개선소위원장은 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “보통 패스트트랙이 (심사에) 330일 정도 소요되는데 현재 법안 처리 시한이 그보다 짧다”며 “약 300여일 정도 안에 법안이 심사·처리되고 있기 때문에 이 제도의 취지와 이름에 걸맞게 처리 기간을 단축할 필요가 있다고 판단했다”고 말했다.)

Under the current National Assembly Act, fast-track bills take up to 330 days: 180 days in standing committees, 90 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and 60 days for plenary session referral. However, the amendment reduces the review period to a maximum of 90 days, with 60 days for standing committees, 30 days for the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and referral to the first plenary session after passing the full committee meeting of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee. National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik also said at a press briefing that day regarding the fast-track system, “There are criticisms that it has become ineffective or that the maximum review period of nearly a year, 330 days, is too long, and we need to examine this reasonably.” The People Power Party opposed the bill’s passage and walked out before the vote. Kim Seung-soo, the deputy floor leader for legislative affairs, said, “It’s a declaration of war to reenact the majority ruling party’s parliamentary violence.” The People Power Party is considering launching a filibuster (legal obstruction of proceedings through unlimited debate) if the Democratic Party puts the National Assembly Act amendment on the agenda for the plenary session on the 30th. <<> Meanwhile, the National Assembly Operations Improvement Subcommittee decided to continue reviewing revisions to the filibuster system. Currently, a filibuster can be ended if more than three-fifths of all members approve. The Democratic Party is considering lowering the threshold to end a filibuster to one-fifth of all members. The day before, Democratic Party floor leader Park Chan-dae said, “Since the 22nd National Assembly began, the People Power Party has abused the filibuster a total of 32 times,” adding, “A system designed to protect minority opinions is paralyzing the National Assembly.” (지금 국회법엔 패스트트랙 안건은 상임위 180일, 법제사법위원회 90일, 본회의 부의 60일 등 심사에 최장 330일이 걸린다. 그러나 개정안은 ‘상임위 60일, 법사위 30일, 법사위 전체회의 통과 뒤 열리는 첫 본회의 상정’으로 심사 기간을 최장 90일로 줄였다. 조정식 국회의장도 이날 기자간담회에서 패스트트랙 제도에 관해 “유명무실화하거나 (최장 심사 기간이) 1년 가까이, 330일 진행되며 너무 긴 것 아니냐는 비판도 있는데 합리적으로 같이 볼 필요는 있다”고 말했다. 국민의힘은 법안 처리에 반발하며 의결 전 퇴장했다. 김승수 원내운영수석부대표는 “다수 여당의 의회 폭거를 재현하겠다는 선전포고”라고 말했다. 국민의힘은 민주당이 오는 30일 본회의에 국회법 개정안을 상정하면 필리버스터(무제한 토론을 통한 합법적 의사진행 방해)에 나서는 방안을 검토 중이다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (이런 가운데 국회운영개선소위는 필리버스터 제도 개편은 좀더 심사를 이어가기로 했다. 지금은 재적의원 5분의 3이상이 찬성하면 필리버스터를 종결할 수 있다. 민주당은 이를 재적의원 5분의 1로 하는 등 필리버스터 해제 요건을 낮추는 방안을 검토하고 있다. 전날 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 “22대 국회 들어 국민의힘이 남발한 필리버스터만 무려 32번”이라며 “소수의 의견을 보호하기 위해 마련한 제도가 국회를 마비시키고 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: U.S. Ambassador Michelle Steel to Assume Post This Week… Focus on Coordinating Issues Such as U.S. Investment and Coupang (미셸 스틸 미국대사 금주 부임…대미투자·쿠팡 등 현안 조율 촉각)
item.description:
Michelle Steel, the first U.S. ambassador to South Korea under the second Donald Trump administration, will arrive in Korea on the 30th. With sensitive issues between South Korea and the U.S. piling up—including American investment, tariffs, uranium enrichment and reprocessing, and the Coupang matter—attention is focused on Ambassador Steel’s actions. (도널드 트럼프 2기 행정부의 첫 주한 미국대사인 미셸 스틸 대사가 오는 30일 한국에 부임한다. 대미투자와 관세, 우라늄 농축 재처리와 쿠팡 문제 등 한미 간 껄끄러운 현안이 쌓인 상태라 스틸 대사의 행보에 관심이 쏠린다.)

Ambassador Steel is expected to focus on ensuring that Korea’s investment in the U.S., amounting to $350 billion, moves forward quickly—a key concern for the U.S. Some analysts suggest that U.S. complaints about delayed Korean investment in America are also affecting the delay in negotiations on South Korea-U.S. nuclear cooperation. (스틸 대사는 미국의 주요 관심사인 3500억달러 규모에 이르는 한국의 대미 투자가 신속하게 이뤄지도록 하는 데 주력할 것으로 보인다. 대미투자가 늦어진다는 미국의 불만이 한미 원자력 협상 지연에도 영향을 미치고 있다는 분석도 있다.)

The Coupang issue is also sensitive. Earlier this month, the U.S. House Judiciary Committee argued that “the Korean government is discriminating against Coupang.” There is also interest in what role she will play in conflicts between the two countries over religious issues, including the case of Pastor Son Hyun-bo, who was arrested and later released on charges of violating the Public Official Election Act. Amid these developments, Foreign Minister Kang Kyung-wha made an unusual visit to Korea from the 15th to the 19th to share pending issues between South Korea and the U.S. with the presidential office and various ministries. (쿠팡 문제 역시 민감하다. 이달 초 미 하원 법제사법위원회는 “한국 정부가 쿠팡을 차별하고 있다”고 주장한 바 있다. 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 구속됐다 풀려난 손현보 목사 건을 비롯한 종교 문제 등을 둘러싼 한미 간 갈등 요인에서 그가 어떤 역할을 할지도 관심사다. 이런 가운데 지난 15∼19일 강경화 주미대사가 이례적으로 귀국해 청와대와 각 부처와 한미 현안을 공유하기도 했다.)

Ambassador Steel, a Republican politician, is known to have direct communication with President Trump. (공화당 정치인인 미셸 대사는 트럼프 대통령과 직접 소통할 수 있는 인물로 알려져 있다.)

With the U.S. ambassador to South Korea position filled after being vacant for a year and a half, there are expectations for smoother communication between South Korea and the U.S. However, some express concerns, noting that during her time as a congresswoman, Steel advocated for strengthening U.S. checks on China and improving the human rights of North Korean defectors, and opposed the Moon Jae-in government’s push for an end-of-war declaration between the two Koreas. (1년6개월 동안 공석이던 주한 미국대사 자리가 채워지면서 한미 간 소통이 원활해질 것이란 기대가 있다. 하지만 일각에서는 스틸 대사가 의원 시절 미국의 중국 견제 강화와 탈북민 인권 개선을 주장하고, 문재인 정부가 추진했던 남북 종전선언에 반대했다는 점에서 우려의 목소리도 나온다.)

Ambassador Steel was born in Seoul in 1955 and immigrated to the U.S. in the mid-1970s. She later served two terms as a U.S. House of Representatives member from California. She is the second Korean-American U.S. ambassador to South Korea, following former Ambassador Sung Kim (2011-2014). (스틸 대사는 1955년 서울에서 태어나 1970년대 중반 미국으로 이민갔다. 이후 캘리포니아주에서 두차례 연방 하원의원을 지냈다. 한국계 주한 미국대사는 성 김 전 대사(2011∼2014년)에 이어 두 번째다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "If President Lee Pushes for Re-election Constitutional Amendment, That Would Be a True Insurrection" (장동혁 “이 대통령, 연임 개헌 추진하면 그거야말로 진정한 내란”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, said on the 28th, "If President Lee Jae-myung defies the will of the people, defies the current spirit of the constitution, and truly pursues a constitutional amendment for re-election, that in itself would be a genuine insurrection." This came in response to National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik's morning press briefing, where he stated that "a constitutional amendment allowing a sitting president's re-election is a matter of the people's choice," to which Jang retorted that "a re-election constitutional amendment is an insurrection." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 28일 “이재명 대통령이 국민의 뜻을 거스르고, 지금의 헌법 정신을 거스르고, 정말 연임 개헌을 추진한다면 그것이 바로 진정한 내란이 될 것”이라고 말했다. 조정식 국회의장이 이날 오전 기자간담회에서 “현직 대통령의 연임 개헌은 국민 선택의 문제”라고 말한 데 대해 ‘연임 개헌은 내란’이라고 반발한 것이다.)

Assemblyman Jang held an emergency press conference at the National Assembly that afternoon, saying, "President Lee Jae-myung took Assemblyman Woo Won-shik as a special adviser (to the Presidential Office), and it seems he gave him special training to push forward this kind of constitutional amendment." (장 대표는 이날 오후 국회에서 긴급기자회견을 열어 “이재명 대통령이 조정식 의원을 (청와대) 특보로 데려가더니 이런 개헌을 하기 위한 특별 교육을 시켰나보다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Assemblyman Jang asserted, "The abolition of supplementary investigative powers has stirred up the nation, and the 'Mutual Mortgage' on real estate is fueling public anger to the skies. Today, the KOSPI fell 11%, barely holding onto the 6000 mark. In the year since the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, it has wrecked every system in South Korea, and the stock market has become a hellfire." He added, "There's already talk that the next four years will be long. How much more do they intend to destroy South Korea and plunge the people into suffering, by bringing up Lee Jae-myung's re-election at this very moment?" (장 대표는 “보완수사권 폐지 때문에 대한민국이 떠들썩하고, 부동산 ‘더불어근저당’으로 국민 분노가 하늘 찌르고 있다. 오늘 코스피가 11% 하락하면서 6000선을 가까스로 지켰다”며 “이재명 정부가 들어서 1년 동안 대한민국 모든 시스템을 망가뜨리고, 주식시장은 이제 지옥불이 됐다”고 주장했다. 그러면서 “앞으로 4년도 길다는 이야기가 나오고 있는데 대한민국을 얼마나 더 무너뜨리고 국민을 얼마나 더 고통에 빠뜨리려고 지금 이 순간에 이재명 연임을 이야기하고 있나”고 했다.)

Assemblyman Jang claimed, "The Democratic Party has always brought up a one-point constitutional amendment whenever we talked about the spirit of the May 18th Gwangju Uprising or election commission reform. Knowing their true intentions, I've repeatedly said that if President Lee Jae-myung would just state unequivocally that he'll never seek re-election, regardless of whether it's a one-point amendment or any other constitutional change, it would be easier to trust his sincerity and begin discussions on the amendment. Now, they've finally revealed their true colors." He continued, "In the end, it was just a matter of them testing the waters here and there to pursue re-election. There's nothing else in their heads." (장 대표는 “(민주당은) 그동안 5·18 정신, 선관위 개혁을 얘기할 때마다 원포인트 개헌을 얘기했다. 그 속내를 알고 있기 때문에 원포인트 개헌이든 무슨 개헌이든 이재명 대통령이 절대 연임 안 하겠다는 말만 하면 그 진정성을 믿고 개헌 논의에 착수하기 더 쉬울 거라는 얘기를 계속했는데, 드디어 속내를 드러냈다”고 주장했다. 이어 “결국 연임하기 위해 여기저기 찔러봤던 것밖에 안 된다. 그거 외에 머릿속에 아무것도 없다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker’s Office Clarifies on Cho Jung-sik’s Remarks: “Not About Possibility of Incumbent President’s Re-election” (국회의장실, 조정식 발언에 “현직 대통령 연임 가능성 뜻 아냐” 해명)
item.description:
Amid controversy sparked on the 28th by National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik’s mention of the “possibility of the incumbent president’s re-election,” the National Assembly Speaker’s Office issued an official explanation, stating, “This was a statement of principle that constitutional amendments should proceed based on national consensus and political agreement.” <<> Jang Hyun-joo, Senior Secretary for Public Communication at the National Assembly Speaker’s Office, held a briefing at the main building of the National Assembly that afternoon and said, “Speaker Cho is fully aware of the provision (Article 128, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution) that stipulates constitutional amendments for extending the presidential term or changing term limits do not apply to the president in office at the time of the proposal.” She added, “Reports suggesting that the possibility of the incumbent president’s re-election was left open are completely different from the intent of the remarks.” <<> Earlier that morning, during his first press conference since taking office, Speaker Cho had said, “Regarding the restructuring of power structures, the issue of the incumbent president’s re-election is a matter of public opinion and choice.” <<> By Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (28일 조정식 국회의장의 ‘현직 대통령 연임 가능성’ 언급이 논란을 일으킨 가운데, 국회의장실은 “개헌은 국민적 공감대와 정치권 합의를 바탕으로 진행돼야 한다는 원론적 입장을 밝힌 것”이라는 공식 해명을 내놓았다.)

item.title: ‘Jang Dong-hyuk’s Praetorian Guard’ Ragged 3-Member Ethics Committee…Dispute Over Legitimacy of Disciplinary Actions Spreads (‘장동혁 친위대’ 누더기 3인 윤리위…징계 정당성 논란 번져)
item.description:
The People Power Party’s Central Ethics Committee, with only the minimum quorum of three members present, decided on the 27th to initiate disciplinary proceedings against lawmakers Cho Kyoung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh, sparking growing internal dissent. Critics argue that a decision made by a tiny number of ethics committee members aligned with leader Jang Dong-hyuk’s stance is unlikely to secure legitimacy. <<> Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop said on YTN Radio on the 28th: “The Ethics Committee holds immense power to discipline, and even expel, nationally elected lawmakers, so its composition and procedures must be flawless. But initiating discipline with just a bare quorum of three will lead to problems. It’s not a good thing for it to act as someone’s knife or hunting dog.” <<> Lawmaker Cho Kyoung-tae, who was subject to the disciplinary initiation the previous day, also stated at a National Assembly press conference: “The party constitution and rules stipulate that the Central Ethics Committee should consist of up to nine members. But due to repeated dysfunction from resignations, the decision (to initiate discipline) made yesterday by just three hands lacks procedural legitimacy.” Cho was targeted for disciplinary action for campaigning against the election of National Assembly Vice Speaker candidate Park Deok-heum during the plenary session’s vote for the opposition’s vice speaker. Another lawmaker, who is not strongly factional, commented: “I don’t understand why the Ethics Committee is rushing to impose discipline with only a bare quorum.” The party’s constitution and rules only state that the Ethics Committee should be composed of up to nine members, with no lower limit set. The party leadership cites this as grounds to argue that “the resolution has no issues.” <<> The People Power Party leadership launched the Ethics Committee in January with seven members. However, three Ethics Committee members immediately resigned after their names were made public. The party then appointed two new members, restoring the committee to six. After the June 3 local elections, it appointed media spokesperson Jeong Kyoung-wook, bringing the count back to seven. But recently, conflicts intensified over the operational policy of committee chair Yoon Min-woo, leading two more Ethics Committee members to resign in succession within a week, reducing the total to five. Amid this, Vice Chair Woo Jong-hwan and member Hwang Kyung-sung issued a statement criticizing Yoon Min-woo on the 27th and boycotted the day’s meeting. <<> Within the party, there was backlash from those targeted—who argued the disciplinary initiation targets anti-Jang Dong-hyuk lawmakers—and criticism from non-mainstream members. Lawmaker Jin Jong-oh, facing discipline for supporting independent candidate Han Dong-hoon in the June 3 Busan North-Gap by-election, wrote on Facebook: “What the People Power Party needs is not intimidation-style disciplinary politics for factional control, but to recover public sentiment. The public won’t vote for a party that turns its knives inward.” Cho Kyoung-tae also protested: “History will surely judge the unscrupulous targeted discipline by Jang Dong-hyuk’s private ‘Avatar Committee.’ Is this truly legitimate discipline? Or is it political retaliation to shield party power?” <<> At the floor leaders’ meeting, a heated debate erupted over the disciplinary decision against Kwon Young-jin, who had grabbed the collar of floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik and others after complaining about the allocation of parliamentary standing committee seats. Lawmaker Cho Eun-hee said: “When there’s a sincere apology, we should give a chance to work together again.” In contrast, lawmaker Yoo Young-ha countered: “A party that shields violence because it’s from a comrade cannot exist.” Floor leader Jeong then defused the situation, saying: “Let’s discuss political views privately.” <<> Reported by Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr and Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회가 지난 27일 최하 정족수인 단 3명의 윤리위원만 참석한 가운데 조경태·권영진·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 개시를 결정한 데 대해 당내 반발이 확산하고 있다. 특히 장동혁 대표의 성향과 일치하는 극소수 윤리위원들의 결정은 정당성을 확보하기 어려운 것 아니냐는 비판이 나온다.)

item.title: Passport, Accelerating Review of Bill to Abolish Supplementary Investigation Rights – Concerns Over ‘Hasty Review’ (여권, 보완수사 폐지안 처리 속도전…‘날림 심사’ 우려도)
item.description:
The National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, led by the ruling Democratic Party of Korea and affiliated pro-government parties, has launched an expedited review of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment bill aimed at abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights, targeting a plenary session vote on the 30th. However, the opposition party is protesting that the review of a special counsel bill concerning the election commission, triggered by the shortage of ballot papers, should take precedence, raising expectations of conflict before the bill can be brought to the floor. As the review proceeds under time pressure, concerns over a 'slapdash review' are also emerging. <<> Kim Seung-won, a member of the Democratic Party and chair of the First Subcommittee for Bill Review, stated at a subcommittee plenary meeting on the morning of the 28th, "Negotiations on the special counsel bill for the election commission are still ongoing among the floor leadership of the negotiating groups," putting the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, which was originally a lower-priority agenda item, up for review first. In response, Park Hyung-soo of the People Power Party, the opposition party's secretary on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, objected, saying, "There is a huge difference of opinion between the two parties on the Criminal Procedure Act. There is a risk of failure, so if we discuss the Criminal Procedure Act first and it breaks down, we won't be able to discuss the special counsel bill we promised to the people." Subsequently, People Power Party lawmakers left the meeting room and returned only late in the afternoon to resume the review. <<> The Democratic Party, after holding a general meeting of lawmakers on the 24th to approve the Criminal Procedure Act amendment bill abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights as a party policy, has been speeding up the handling of the bill. The target is to review it in the subcommittee on this day, pass it in the full Legislation and Judiciary Committee meeting on the 29th, and then have it processed in the plenary session on the 30th. <<> However, as the revision process is proceeding hastily, there are criticisms that despite the significant impact of the law on the people, there is insufficient time to properly review the details. For instance, there may be a lack of thorough examination regarding whether supplementary measures reflected in the bill—such as 'substantializing the right to request supplementary investigations' and 'mandating the referral of seven major crimes against socially vulnerable individuals to the prosecution'—conflict with existing laws or whether their effectiveness can be guaranteed. <<> Lawmaker Park Hyung-soo said at the People Power Party's floor strategy meeting on this day, "(The Democratic Party's unilateral bill review) means treating the first opposition party lawmakers as mere voting machines," and added, "If the Democratic Party ignores our warnings and unilaterally puts this bill on the plenary agenda, we will mobilize all means, including unlimited debate, to strongly block it." <<> Meanwhile, the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials (CIO) announced on this day that it had submitted an opinion to the National Assembly stating that investigative procedures—such as emergency arrests, detention periods, and searches and seizures—should be directly stipulated in the CIO Act. The opinion also included a proposal to establish a new 'additional investigation request' procedure, allowing prosecution investigators to assess the need for supplementary investigations. CIO spokesperson Kim Baek-ki explained, "The aim is to minimize the potential for interpretive disputes by directly regulating investigative procedures in the CIO Act." <<> Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr Reporter Lim Cheol-hwi hwi@hani.co.kr (국회 법제사법위원회가 더불어민주당 등 범여권 주도로 오는 30일 본회의 처리를 목표로 하는 ‘검사의 보완수사권 폐지’ 형사소송법(형소법) 개정안 심사 ‘속도전’에 들어갔다. 그러나 야당은 ‘투표용지 부족 사태에 따른 선거관리위원회 특검법’ 심사가 먼저라고 반발하고 있어 본회의 상정까지 진통이 예상된다. 처리 시한에 쫓겨서 심사가 진행되다 보니 ‘졸속 심사’에 대한 우려도 나온다.)
